home.headline: I build interfaces that feel considered.
home.lede: Front-end developer with six years in production React, and ten years as a graphic designer before that. Loading states, transitions and micro-feedback are not polish added at the end. They are the product.

about.title: About
about.body: I spent ten years designing for print and the last six building front-ends. Today I work on a sports content platform: fourteen microfrontends over Module Federation, an AI canvas generation pipeline, production server-side rendering, and WCAG 2.1 accessibility.
about.aside: The design years are not decoration on the CV. They are why I notice when a layout is a quarter of a millimetre out, and why I think an interface without loading states is unfinished.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lede: Open to front-end and full-stack work across Europe.
